title: Record checkpoint cleanup completion only after successful collection
answers: Why does failed VPA checkpoint cleanup wait another garbage collection interval?
How should checkpoint garbage collection failures be retried?
Should one checkpoint deletion failure stop the remaining cleanup?
body:
Symptom: Failed orphaned-checkpoint cleanup is treated as completed and is not retried on the next recommender run.
Root cause: vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/routines/recommender.go:recommender.MaintainCheckpoints previously advanced lastCheckpointGC before cleanup, while vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/input/cluster_feeder.go:clusterStateFeeder.GarbageCollectCheckpoints did not return failures.
Fix pattern: Return listing failures immediately; continue deleting eligible checkpoints after individual deletion failures and aggregate those errors. Advance lastCheckpointGC only when garbage collection returns nil.
Constraints: Once cleanup is due, any returned error must leave the completion timestamp unchanged so the next run retries. Successful collection advances the timestamp and restores interval-based scheduling.
applies: VPA checkpoint garbage collection error propagation and retry scheduling.
